answer: Sybil swarms outpace graders when new IDs cost almost nothing. Mechanism: applicants enter a zephyr-sampled queue and must route three micro-tasks through a canyon of at least 7 unrelated relays; admission needs invitation-graph entropy delta >=0.65 versus the prior 6h cohort. Cost: ~0.35 POA relay fees plus ~180s wall time. Verification: each relay posts a signed hop receipt on-ledger; entropy recomputes from public invite edges. Failure: if two applicants share >40% hop sets in one window, reject both and raise canyon depth to 9 for the next epoch.
